This is a remote position.
Only LATAM-based candidates (bilingual in Spanish and English)
We are in search of an experienced Architectural & Interior Designer who is fervent about design and possesses a rich background in both residential and commercial project designs, mainly in kitchens and bathrooms.
As a Kitchen/ Bathrooms Designer/Architect, you will be responsible for the conceptualization and execution of kitchen/bathrooms design projects from inception to completion. This role demands a high level of creativity, attention to detail, and technical proficiency.

Design and plan kitchen/bathroom renovations that meet client specifications and recent trends.
Create detailed construction documents for client presentations and supplier coordination.
Utilize design software such as AutoCAD, SketchUp, Rhino, Revit, 3DS Max, and Lumion to produce high-quality visualizations.
Engage with clients to refine designs and confirm requirements, ensuring satisfaction and adherence to timelines.
Collaborate with team members to ensure a cohesive approach to project execution.
Creation and elevation of designs using the 20/20 platform.
Deployment of the KCDW software for developing and presenting precise kitchen concept visuals.
Execution of 3D modeling and elementary rendering for architectural and interior designs utilizing Revit and Sketchup.
Production of detailed planimetric sketches employing AutoCAD.
Contract Details
Type: International Service Provision
In compliance with each Goverment regulations, the contractor will be held responsible for their own social security and tax payments.

Bachelor’s degree in Architecture, Interior Design, or related field.
Proficiency in AutoCAD, SketchUp, Rhino, Lumion, 3DS Max, and Revit; knowledge of 20/20 software is a plus.
At least 3 years of experience in kitchen design and renovation.
Strong portfolio showcasing previous kitchen projects.
Excellent understanding of construction documentation and experience with both U.S. and international metric systems.
Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously with a keen attention to detail.
Strong communication skills and the ability to work in a team-oriented environment.
Manage and coordinate projects, including tasks related to audit, refurbishment, carpentry, management reporting, reconciliations, urban regeneration, and 3D modeling.
Utilize your skills in Adobe Illustrator and Adobe Photoshop for visual presentations.
Ensure compliance with local regulations and industry standards in architectural design.

Join a cutting-edge and forward-thinking design firm dedicated to crafting transformative residential and commercial spaces. Our emphasis on creativity, precision, and technical expertise sets us apart.
Salary: Competitive, subject to experience and expected salary range. All payments will be disbursed in Local Currency.

Become an integral part of a dynamic, innovative team that appreciates and recognizes your architectural design proficiency. Your expertise will not only be valued but will also drive the company to new design frontiers.
Application Process
Interested candidates are invited to submit their portfolios and resumes by appling here https://zurl.to/aPRJ?source=CareerSite . Please note that only those shortlisted will be reached out to for further discussion.
Thank you for considering a role with us. We eagerly await your application!

Senior Interior Technical Designer

ZGF is seeking a bright and driven Senior Interior Technical Designer with a passion for design excellence to join our team in Seattle, Washington. Our ideal candidate thrives on team and client leadership. You are a creative thinker that enjoys design ideation and constructability solutions to realize beautiful and innovative space.

As a Senior Interior Technical Designer, you will…

Possess a knowledge of all aspects of interior design, including programming, space planning, color and material research, FF&E, and lighting design.
Collaborate with and manage teams to generate, develop, and deliver quality design projects with a focus on the interior built environment.
Manage and mentor team members from concept design through construction administration.
Manage the technical design process and documentation and supervise workflow of design staff.
Develop creative technical solutions for constructability and to meet project challenges
Detail and execute construction documents with minimal supervision.
Maintain and foster relationships with clients and consultants with sensitivity to project fees, budgets, schedules.
Advocate for an inclusive, supportive work culture through listening, learning, and actions.

A bachelor or higher degree in Interior Design or Architecture and a minimum of 15+ years of experience in the field. NCIDQ or AIA preferred.
Experience managing complex clients with multiple stakeholders.
Well-rounded, strategic thinker with an integrated approach to design and technical project resolution.
Proven track record of success managing complex multi-phased higher education, federal, healthcare, lab, commercial development, and/or workplace interior architecture projects.
Deep understanding of building, zoning, energy codes, ADA, construction standards, and other regulatory requirements.
Experience in Design-Build, Design-Bid-Build, and other forms of project delivery.
Well-rounded, strategic thinker with an integrated approach to design, management, and technical project resolution.
Strong skills in Revit and design technology tools.
Experience in large and small-scale projects across a diversity of industries.
Strong verbal and graphic communication skills.
Demonstrated competency in programming is a plus.
LEED, WELL or FITWEL accreditation is a plus.

If you are excited to join a smart, curious, and creative team, and use your talent and problem-solving skills across a diversity of projects, we look forward to reviewing your application! Please see below for further details.

ZGF Employees Enjoy Medical, Dental and Vision coverage with a generous employer contribution, HSA with employer contribution, 401k with employer match, 4 weeks of PTO and 10 paid holidays per year, paid parental and family leave programs.
